header.notes: Rows contain derived rates/counts only. The shared map's religious_affiliation_percent metric slot displays church seating per 100 population for 1850-1890, members per 100 population for 1906-1936, and adherents per 100 population for 1952-2020; the US page labels the construct shift explicitly.
